findings.title: Remove the hardcoded API key fallback.
findings.rationale:
This value is credential-like and is committed to source control. If it is valid, anyone with repository access can use it. Any deployment without SERVICE_API_KEY will also use the same shared credential.

The value starts with sk-live-, which conflicts with the staging-key comment. Remove it, revoke and rotate it if it is real, and load development credentials through explicit local configuration instead. Do not silently fall back in non-local environments.
